snippet.title: [Kakegurui ALL IN] Official Game Release!
snippet.description:
Based on the hit TV anime "Kakegurui," "Kakegurui ALL IN" is finally here!

The game runs directly on web browsers for smartphones, tablets, and PCs. No app download is required. Enjoy the ease of browser gaming combined with the intense mix of strategy and luck that defines a brand-new Kakegurui experience.

Start the game here: https://s.g123.jp/puusv20n

■ Game Information
Game Title: Kakegurui ALL IN
Genre: Strategic Sugoroku
Price: Free (In-game item purchases available)

#Kakegurui #KakeguruiALLIN #G123 #FreeGame
